stories.title: Geometry Primitives - Angle and Direction
stories.description: Implement shared angle/direction conversion functions: letter_to_angle, number_to_angle, angle_to_letter, normalize_angle, opposite_angle, average_angles. These are used by MouseClock, Concentric Box, and Line Overlay systems.
acceptanceCriteria: letter_to_angle converts A-L to degrees (A=30, B=60, ..., L=0/360)
number_to_angle converts 1-12 clock hours to degrees
angle_to_letter returns nearest clock letter for any angle
normalize_angle constrains any angle to 0-360 range
average_angles correctly handles wraparound (e.g., averaging 350 and 10)

stories.title: Geometry Primitives - Point and Vector Math
stories.description: Implement point/vector math functions: move_in_direction, distance_between, point_on_circle, clamp_to_bounds. Used by all navigation systems for position calculations.
acceptanceCriteria: move_in_direction computes point at given angle/distance from origin
distance_between returns Euclidean distance between two points
point_on_circle returns point on circle perimeter at given angle
clamp_to_bounds constrains point to stay within a rectangle
